ValidationRule.description: Submission date is needed to track funder turnaround times and prevent duplicate submissions.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Awarded"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Declined"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "In Progress"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Reporting Due"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Closed")), ISBLANK(Submitted_Date__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Submitted Date is required once a grant has been submitted. Please record when it went out.
